### Bug Analysis

**Bug Scenario Description:**

The bug report and images indicate a need to create an icon-only variant for both Line Tabs and Contained Tabs. The images show the desired layout with icons only, without any text labels.

**Root Cause:**

The current implementation of the `Tabs` and `Tab` components does not support an icon-only variant. The `Tab` component expects a `label` prop, which is not needed for icon-only tabs.

### Bug Localization

The issue lies in the `Tab` component where it requires a `label` prop. We need to modify the `Tab` component to allow rendering without a label when an icon is provided.

### Patches

To fix the issue, we need to update the `Tab` component to conditionally render the label only if it is provided. This will allow the tabs to be rendered with icons only.

```javascript
### packages/react/src/components/Tab/Tab.js
<<<<<<< SEARCH
          <button type="button" role="tab" {...buttonProps}>
            {label}
          </button>
=======
          <button type="button" role="tab" {...buttonProps}>
            {label || null}
          </button>
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```

This change ensures that the `label` is only rendered if it is provided, allowing for icon-only tabs.
